[NSTG.2.1.2] The two cbs share one user pointer — typically a
backing-store handle. A NULL `set_cb` / `delete_cb` is **not** an
error: the write still lands in the engine's cache and is simply not
persisted (a volatile cache, [LSTO.4.3.2]). Registering neither (the
default) is a fully working volatile cache.
